text:
aj: Heads-up — we need to reserve GPU capacity in northamerica-north1 for the new cluster bring-up next month. Target: 12 H100s (or 24 A100s fallback) for the initial canary window.

maria: Thanks. Is this for staging or prod?

aj: Canary staging -> then prod ramp. Bring-up schedule: week of May 18 (2-week warmup + validation). Need quota & reservation by May 5 to lock pricing and regional placement.

Tim: pinging the cloud quota runbook. Do we want a strict reservation (non-preemptible) or burstable?

aj: Non-preemptible preferred for deterministic latency during evals. We can mix 50% reserved + 50% burstable if pricing forces it.

sujay: Do we have the exact SKU names for the provider? I can file the request.

aj: GCP-like names: "NVIDIA-H100-80GB" (we use internal tag H100-80), fallback "A100-80GB" (A100-80). Region: northamerica-north1. Zone affinity: prefer c1+c2 to avoid cross-zone KV cache misses.

maria: cost questions: finance needs an estimate before approval. Rough numbers?

finance: rough calc — H100 reserved (1yr commit) roughly $2.7k/mo/GPU list, but committed discounts vary. For 12 H100s ~ $32k/mo list, expect ~25% with commit -> ~$24k/mo. Add network & storage. If we do 3-month term or no commit, expect higher.

aj: Good enough for initial ask. We'll include both reserved and on-demand burst options in the QREQ so provider can advise.

infra-bot: Created draft quota ticket: QREQ-76921. Add approval docs and cost sign-off.

cloud-support: Hi — we see QREQ-76921. Need: project IDs, exact SKUs, desired quotas per zone, start/end date for reservation, and whether you need placement-group affinity.

aj: Project: redwood-north1-bringup. SKUs: H100-80 (12), fallback A100-80 (24). Zones: north1-c1:6, north1-c2:6. Start: 2026-05-18. End: 2026-06-01 (initial warmup), with option to extend to 2026-09-01 for prod ramp. Placement-group: yes, prefer same placement for latency-sensitive services.

maria: I'll drop the runbook link here for the ticket: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bringup-gpu-quota.md

Tim: For the cloud support payload, use this sample snippet (paste into provider form):

```
{
  "project_id": "redwood-north1-bringup",
  "region": "northamerica-north1",
  "requested_skus": [
    {"sku": "H100-80", "count": 12, "zones": {"north1-c1": 6, "north1-c2": 6}, "reservation_type": "standard"},
    {"sku": "A100-80", "count": 24, "zones": {"north1-c1": 12, "north1-c2": 12}, "reservation_type": "fallback"}
  ],
  "start_date": "2026-05-18",
  "end_date": "2026-09-01",
  "notes": "Initial canary warmup 2026-05-18..06-01. Will validate KV cache and end-to-end throughput. Contact aj@m.redwood.com for escalation."
}
```

sujay: Filing now. Will attach cost sheet and include a request for a short-term reservation hold (72h) to allow us to finalize PO.

cloud-support: Added 72h hold request. We can escalate to sales for a formal reservation quote. Need billing contact and estimate of sustained utilization (pct).

finance: sustained util expectation: 60% during warmup, 85% in prod ramp. We'll include that.

aj: Also request provider enable quota soft-fallback: if H100 capacity can't be guaranteed, they should automatically offer A100s with pre-approved substitution to avoid timing outage. Add a note: latency SLAs apply, test with 512-token baseline.

oncall: Add SRE testing checklist to ticket: boot times (90% < 2m), kernel panic rate < 0.1% during stress, NVLink topology checks, perf counters export to datadog.

eng-prod: For canary validation we need a smoke script that runs 100 inference requests concurrently across 4 pods. I'll add the script to the ticket.

maria: Reminder: network egress paths need capacity. If cross-region ingress spikes, we need a pre-provisioned transit gateway. Add that requirement to the QREQ.

cloud-support: Noted. We'll coordinate network provisioning with infra team. Please add subnet CIDR ranges and firewall exceptions.

aj: Subnets: 10.240.16.0/20 (compute), 10.240.32.0/24 (control plane). Firewall: allow internal 10.240.0.0/16, control plane to nodes on ports 22, 443, 8080, 9090.

sujay: Ticket updated with payload, subnets, and cost sheet. Filing reference: QREQ-76921-PROV.

infra-bot: QREQ-76921-PROV moved to vendor-sales queue. Estimated vendor response time: 48-72h.

Tim: Next steps checklist: 1) cloud vendor quote & reservation confirmation, 2) finance PO or temporary approval, 3) SRE prereq: image bake & kernel config, 4) infra: network & route tables, 5) canary smoke run + perf benchmark, 6) handoff doc + oncall rota.

aj: Assigning owners: finance -> maria, SRE -> oncall, infra -> sujay, eng-prod -> tim. Handoff date to SRE: 2026-05-20.

finance: Will try to fast-track PO for a 3-month trial to start while we evaluate commit options.

cloud-support: Vendor replied — capacity looks available but H100 lead time may be limited in north1. Sales offered a temporary regional reservation with 14-day retention at list price, convertible to 1yr commit. Quote ID: VQ-2244. Attaching quote to ticket.

aj: Good. We'll accept the temporary hold to avoid losing placement. Sujay, can you confirm the canary test dates still match if we accept a shorter reservation window?

sujay: Yes — can run warmup earlier by 48 hours if vendor needs to start earlier.

aj: OK, authorize the temporary hold. Maria, please approve the PO and we’ll convert to a commit after perf validation.

maria: Approving temp hold PO now. Sending to finance for signature.

infra-bot: QREQ-76921-PROV status: HOLD_AUTHORIZED. Vendor hold expires 2026-05-07 03:00 UTC unless converted.

oncall: I'll prep the SRE runbook and add a freeze window for kernel updates during the warmup.

eng-prod: We'll run end-to-end tests and log the perf metrics. If 512-token latencies exceed target (p50 < 60ms), fallback to A100 and notify oncall.

aj: Thanks all. I'll update the internal bringup tracker and close this thread once vendor confirms full reservation.

cloud-support: Confirmed — temporary hold applied. Follow-ups in ticket QREQ-76921-PROV.

maria: One last ask — add a note to the ticket about the rollback plan: if reserve fails, spin up a hybrid cluster in us-west2 with 50% capacity mirrored.

aj: Added rollback plan.

infra-bot: Thread closed (auto-archive) — final ticket QREQ-76921-PROV.

aj: (small) thanks everyone :thumbsup:
